This first phase is quiet returning water / low foam, delicate open irregular lace, not a solid band. Tactical RPG three-quarter top-down surface, upper-left light. Match viewed SKL-SF wave_foam_01 style using hard deliberate pixel clusters and crisp white foam crests with restrained cyan rims, detailed yet readable at96x48; no blur, no soft glow. Keep contact line, width and overall layout fixed, all foam fully inside canvas. No UI/text/labels, no frame/border, no sheet or montage, no characters. Draw new artwork, do not trace/crop/composite the scene reference. One single foam animation frame; do not draw the cliff itself.
